hooks.command: echo 'Compaction instructions: keep in the summary the slug of the task in progress, its folder .agents/local/tasks/<task-slug>/, what is done, the current state (branch, uncommitted files, tests), the next step, ruled-out ideas and open questions.'

echo 'The context was just compacted. If a task is in progress: re-read its .agents/local/tasks/<task-slug>/plan.md and handoff.md, bring handoff.md up to date from the summary (template .agents/templates/handoff.md), then continue. Never write task state into .agents/context/.'
